title: 第3768章 死地突围噬魂骨魔第3767章 擒逃博弈暗令潜谋
content_zh:
第3768章死地突围，噬魂骨魔
魔王隐匿。
这个他几乎已经快要遗忘的能力此时却发挥了至关重要的力量。
孟婉舒也被李观棋拉进屏障之中。
以李观棋如今的力量也只能维持屏障三丈大小。
此时李观棋才略微松了一口气看向四周的环境。
此时他们所处之地好像是一片连绵不绝的群山之中……
只是这山峰的环境有些奇怪。
入眼之处皆是灰白色的山石，可若是仔细看去，却又能看到一些可怕的巨骨堆叠！
群山之间弥漫着诡异的灰白色浓雾，目之所及不过十丈范围。
更加诡异的是，这灰白浓雾竟可以阻断神识的扫视。
四周温度略低，让李观棋的神魂感到有些不适。
可仅仅只是过了数息，李观棋就察觉到了不太对劲儿。
孟婉舒眉头一皱，转头时刚好与李观棋的目光相遇。
四目相对，孟婉舒单手捂着胸口，眼眸虚眯地回望四周，压低声音开口道。
“夫君，好像有些不太对劲儿。”
李观棋微微点头，沉声传音道。
“确实……”
“太安静了！”
“方圆十里连一点声音都没有，甚至就连一缕风都没有！”

如今整个群山里面就像是一片死地，山谷中的灰白浓雾连动都不动一下，就悬停在固定的位置。
仿佛这山谷中浓雾的起伏形状，都已经很多年都没有改变过了。
又过了数息，李观棋突然眉头一皱。
他察觉到自己所设下的屏障竟然在被那诡异的雾气缓慢地侵蚀着。
不过这种速度并不快，以他的神魂强度还能坚持一段时间。
可这也让李观棋的心里更加不安……
正当李观棋警惕看向四周的时候，双眼微闭的孟婉舒突然睁开眼睛，内视一番缓缓传音道。
“我等挣脱引魂路，未上奈何桥……按照谛听的说法，我们如今都是游魂。”
“我不知道自己的感知是否出了错。”
“好像……我的寿元在飞快地消逝着……”
谛听的兽魂虚影缓缓凝聚在李观棋的肩膀，虎头脑袋微微点头。
“没错，就是魂寿。”
content_en:
Chapter 3768: Breaking through the siege at the dead end, the soul-eating bone demon
The devil is hiding.
This ability that he had almost forgotten now played a vital role.
Meng Wanshu was also pulled into the barrier by Li Guanqi.
With Li Guanqi's current strength, he can only maintain a barrier three feet in size.
At this time, Li Guanqi breathed a sigh of relief and looked at his surroundings.
At this time, the place they were in seemed to be among endless mountains...
It’s just that the environment on this mountain peak is a little strange.
Everything you see is gray-white rocks, but if you look carefully, you can see some terrifying giant bones stacked up!
A strange gray-white thick fog filled the mountains, and the distance as far as the eye could see was no more than ten feet away.
What's even more weird is that this thick gray fog can actually block the scanning of spiritual consciousness.
The surrounding temperature was slightly lower, which made Li Guanqi's soul feel a little uncomfortable.
But just a few breaths later, Li Guanqi noticed something was wrong.
Meng Wanshu frowned, and when she turned her head, she happened to meet Li Guanqi's eyes.
Their eyes met, Meng Wanshu covered her chest with one hand, looked back around with squinted eyes, and spoke in a low voice.
"Husband, something seems not quite right."
Li Guanqi nodded slightly and said in a deep voice.
"Indeed..."
"It's so quiet!"
"There's not even a sound for ten miles, not even a wisp of wind!"
Now the entire mountains are like a dead land, and the thick gray fog in the valley does not even move, just hovering in a fixed position.
It seems that the undulating shape of the dense fog in the valley has not changed for many years.
A few more breaths passed, and Li Guanqi suddenly frowned.
He noticed that the barrier he had set up was slowly being eroded by the strange mist.
However, this speed is not fast, and with the strength of his soul, he can still persist for a while.
But this also made Li Guanqi feel even more uneasy...
Just as Li Guanqi looked around cautiously, Meng Wanshu, whose eyes were slightly closed, suddenly opened her eyes, looked inward and slowly transmitted the message.
"We broke away from the soul-drawing road and didn't get to the Naihe Bridge...According to what Di Ting said, we are all wandering souls now."
"I don't know if my perception is wrong."
"It seems...my longevity is disappearing quickly..."
The phantom of Diting's beast soul slowly condensed on Li Guanqi's shoulder, and his tiger-headed head nodded slightly.
"That's right, it's Hun Shou."
